faqs.q: How long does a sewer line installation take?
faqs.a: Most residential sewer installations can be completed within 2-3 days, depending on the complexity and method used.

faqs.q: Do I need permits for sewer installation in Buffalo?
faqs.a: Yes, sewer installations require permits from the City of Buffalo. We handle all permit applications as part of our service.

faqs.q: What is the average cost of sewer line installation?
